text.offer: Welcome to the Inn of Raza, traveller. You've washed up with little more than the clothes on your back, I see. Before anyone in this town can use you, you'll want something to stop a blow. Take this coin to Tomas, our blacksmith: he'll sell you a shield. Then come back and tell me how it sits on your arm.
text.progress: Tomas keeps the smithy in Raza. People with something for you show a gold "!" or "?" over their heads: right-click Tomas and choose Quests to talk to him, and Buy to see what he sells. Then wear the shield, and come back to Marcus at the inn.
text.complete: Now you look like someone who might come home again. Wear it whenever you leave the town walls.

steps.objective: Buy a small round shield from Tomas
steps.brief: Tomas says, "Marcus sent you? Then here's what I'd give any newcomer: a small round shield. Right-click me and choose Buy, tick the shield, and it's yours. Wear it, then let Marcus see it."
